# Method GetBaseDocument

#### GetBaseDocument(DocumentId)

Gets the base family of a derived family.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 10, 0, 0)]
DocumentId GetBaseDocument(DocumentId inDocumentId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the derived family document to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  Base family document identifier, or empty if the family is not derived.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.10.
